```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
```
## Read TEs df
```{r}
transposons <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/ref_genome/TAIR10_Transposable_Elements.txt")
#transposons$V1 <- gsub("Chr","",transposons$V1)
#transposons$V9 <- gsub("transcript_id .*; gene_id", "", transposons$V9)
#transposons$V9 <- gsub("\"", "", transposons$V9)
#transposons$V9 <- gsub(";", "", transposons$V9)
chromatine_states <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/data_from_pierre/histone_stages/AT_26_segments.bed")
# Extract chromosome name from transposons
transposons$chrom <- gsub("TE.*", "", transposons$Transposon_Name)
transposons$chrom <- gsub("AT", "", transposons$chrom)
transposons$chrom <- as.numeric(transposons$chrom)
```
## Get overlap between chromatine state and transposon
```{r}
# Calculate intersection
library(GenomicRanges)

# Create  TE ranges
tes_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = transposons$chrom,
  ranges = IRanges(start = transposons$Transposon_min_Start, end = transposons$Transposon_max_End)
  , gene_id=transposons$Transposon_Name
)

states_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = chromatine_states$chrom,
  ranges = IRanges(start = chromatine_states$start, end = chromatine_states$end),
  state = chromatine_states$state
)

overlaps <- findOverlaps(tes_gr, states_gr)

overlap_widths <- width(pintersect(tes_gr[queryHits(overlaps)], states_gr[subjectHits(overlaps)]))


overlap_df <- data.frame(
  gene_id = tes_gr$gene_id[queryHits(overlaps)],
  te_start = start(tes_gr)[queryHits(overlaps)],
  te_end = end(tes_gr)[queryHits(overlaps)],
  te_width = width(tes_gr)[queryHits(overlaps)],
  state = states_gr$state[subjectHits(overlaps)],
  overlap_width = overlap_widths,
  overlap_percent = 100 * overlap_widths / width(tes_gr)[queryHits(overlaps)])


```
## TEs that overlap genes at least 1bp 
```{r}
# Group by gene_id and state, sum the overlap percentages
state_summary <- overlap_df %>%
  group_by(gene_id, state) %>%
  summarize(total_overlap_percent = sum(overlap_percent),
            total_overlap_width = sum(overlap_width),
            .groups = "drop")

# Find the dominant state for each TE
dominant_states <- state_summary %>%
  group_by(gene_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = total_overlap_percent, n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_id, dominant_state = state, coverage_percent = total_overlap_percent)

# View the results
dominant_states <- dominant_states[dominant_states$dominant_state=="E4" | dominant_states$dominant_state=="E1" | dominant_states$dominant_state=="E10" |
                                   dominant_states$dominant_state=="E2" | dominant_states$dominant_state=="E3" | dominant_states$dominant_state=="E5" |
                                     dominant_states$dominant_state=="E6" | dominant_states$dominant_state=="E7" | dominant_states$dominant_state=="E8" |
                                     dominant_states$dominant_state=="E9" ,]
write.csv(dominant_states,"/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/11_resources/data_from_pierre/histone_stages/chromatine_stages_tair10tes_euchromatin.csv", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

```{r}

ggplot(dominant_states, aes(dominant_state,coverage_percent))+geom_point()
```
